# A Canadian book whose only US dollars are the ones an invoice collected.
#
# INV-USD-1 bills 2,720.00 USD and is posted on 2026-07-31 at 1.393801
# (usd_at_the_rates_the_statement_lines_records_were_posted_at.yaml), which
# opens the invoice's cost basis on its A/R posting split: 2,720.00 USD at
# 3,791.14 CAD. It is collected into Assets:Wise USD on 2026-08-13. The
# invoice's cost basis is then what the dollars in Wise USD cost, and it is the
# only US dollar cost basis the book keeps.
#
# What this fixture produces: Assets:Wise USD holding 2,720.00 USD and one US
# dollar cost basis, INV-USD-1's, at 2,720.00. Imported with
# `--include-business-objects` and the rates file above.
#
# Verified by
# tests/scenario/test_pending_counts_the_cost_basis_an_invoice_or_a_bill_opened.py.
2026-07-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-07-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-07-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-07-01 open Assets:Wise USD
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-07-01 open Assets:Chequing
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-07-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: "Receivable"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-07-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-07-01 open Income:Sales
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
customer "C-USD"
	name: "Example Customer Inc"
	currency: USD
invoice "INV-USD-1"
	customer_id: "C-USD"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-07-31
	entry:
		date: 2026-07-31
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 2720
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-07-31
		due: 2026-08-30
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-1"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-08-13
		amount: 2720
		account: "Assets:Wise USD"
		memo: "Collected INV-USD-1"
